title: Say Unonan Onkerew na Panamerdona
intro: Pawil ed panaon antis na inmunan isabi na banwa, antis ya walay toon nanakar ed dalin. Sakey a pigura so ginawa manlapud sankaabebaan iran materyales, ya inikdan na posisyon ed tagey na saray anghel, tan inyan ed sakey a sagradon hardin a walaan na malinew a pasakbay. Balet diad sakey a bekta, sakey a pinili so ginawa — sakey a pinili ed amin ya awaran na too. Siopa iyan pigura?
clues: Nianak ak ed paraan ya ag mipara ed arum — pinalsa manlapud dabok na dalin tan inikdan na mabilay a kamarerwa panamegley na lima na Manamalsa.
Naikdan ak na aralem a pikakabat ya anggan saray anghel ed tagey et nankelaw ed satan.
Ingganggan so amin a tawen ya ondakmomo ed arap ko, tan amin da et tinmulok — likud ed sakey, ya ag inmabuloy lapud inkamapaatagey.
Inyan ak ed sakey a sagradon hardin, sakey a pasen na andi-anggaan a ligliwa tan probisyon — balet ta walay sakey a malet a pananebel.
Alingwanan ko, alingo ak, tan ag ak tinmulok — tan aliknak a maong so belat na lingok.
Inmarap ak ed Katawan ko tekep na impapuson salita, tan inawat To so panagbabawi ko, ta Sikato so Sankamamerdona.

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Say Baleg a Delap so imbaki
Sakey a baleg ya apoy so nagmaliw ya ambetel tan maligen
Sakey ya mapaatagey a manuley so nalner ed dayat
Sakey ya armada na saray elepante so aderal

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Say panagbabawi et inawat nen Allah
Say bansa so tinamaan na maksil ya insabog
outcome.answer: Say panagbabawi et inawat nen Allah

arabic: فَتَلَقَّىٰٓ ءَادَمُ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ كَلِمَـٰتٍۢ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verse: Then Adam received from his Lord [some] words, and He accepted his repentance. Indeed, it is He who is the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful. (2:37)
